title: WorkUpdate
description: PATCH /works/{workId}: 제목 바꾸기 and 책 꾸미기 (§12 S0). Only the keys sent change (none sent → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR); the book keeps its place on the shelf (updated_at kept).

title.description: Raw input, checked like POST /works: whitespace collapsed, then 1..100 chars (TITLE_EMPTY, TITLE_TOO_LONG).

cover_id.description: One of this book's covers (404 COVER_NOT_FOUND otherwise); null = cloth cover in the book colour.
